# Project Title: Massive-Scale NLP Preprocessing Pipeline with Pandas, Hugging Face Transformers, and Regex for Document Classification
# Project Ref: ai-ml-ds-vXn7kZrP2Bh

from typing import List, Tuple, Dict, Any
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
import os
import string
import torch
from dataclasses import dataclass
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModel, AutoModelForSequenceClassification, pipeline
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import classification_report, accuracy_score
from datasets import load_dataset
import logging

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)

# CONSTANTS
MODEL_NAME: str = "distilbert-base-uncased"
DATASET_NAME: str = "ag_news"

@dataclass
class TextCleaner:
    lowercase: bool = True
    remove_punct: bool = True
    remove_digits: bool = True
    remove_stopwords: bool = False  # Extendable with NLTK or SpaCy

    def clean(self, text: str) -> str:
        if self.lowercase:
            text = text.lower()
        if self.remove_punct:
            text = re.sub(f"[{re.escape(string.punctuation)}]", "", text)
        if self.remove_digits:
            text = re.sub(r"\d+", "", text)
        text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
        return text

@dataclass
class FeatureExtractor:
    tokenizer: Any
    max_length: int = 128

    def tokenize(self, texts: List[str]) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        return self.tokenizer(texts, padding=True, truncation=True, max_length=self.max_length, return_tensors="pt")

@dataclass
class TextClassifier:
    model_name: str
    device: str = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"

    def __post_init__(self):
        self.tokenizer: AutoTokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self.model_name)
        self.model: AutoModelForSequenceClassification = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(self.model_name).to(self.device)
        self.pipe: Any = pipeline("text-classification", model=self.model, tokenizer=self.tokenizer, device=0 if self.device == "cuda" else -1)

    def predict(self, texts: List[str]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        return self.pipe(texts)

class DataHandler:
    def __init__(self, dataset_name: str):
        self.dataset_name: str = dataset_name
        self.dataset: Any = load_dataset(dataset_name)
        self.df: pd.DataFrame = pd.DataFrame(self.dataset["train"])

    def preprocess(self, cleaner: TextCleaner) -> pd.DataFrame:
        self.df["clean_text"] = self.df["text"].apply(cleaner.clean)
        return self.df

    def encode_labels(self) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, LabelEncoder]:
        le: LabelEncoder = LabelEncoder()
        self.df["label_encoded"] = le.fit_transform(self.df["label"])
        return self.df, le

    def split(self, test_size: float = 0.2) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
        return train_test_split(self.df, test_size=test_size, stratify=self.df["label_encoded"])

class EmbeddingGenerator:
    def __init__(self, model_name: str):
        self.tokenizer: AutoTokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.model: AutoModel = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_name).eval()

    def get_embeddings(self, texts: List[str]) -> np.ndarray:
        tokens: Dict[str, torch.Tensor] = self.tokenizer(texts, padding=True, truncation=True, return_tensors="pt")
        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = self.model(**tokens)
        embeddings = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :].numpy()
        return embeddings

class EvaluationPipeline:
    def __init__(self, classifier: TextClassifier):
        self.classifier: TextClassifier = classifier

    def evaluate(self, x_test: List[str], y_test: List[int], label_encoder: LabelEncoder) -> None:
        preds: List[Dict[str, Any]] = self.classifier.predict(x_test)
        pred_labels: List[int] = [label_encoder.transform([p["label"].split("_")[-1]])[0] for p in preds]
        print(classification_report(y_test, pred_labels))
        print("Accuracy:", accuracy_score(y_test, pred_labels))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    cleaner: TextCleaner = TextCleaner()
    handler: DataHandler = DataHandler(DATASET_NAME)
    df_cleaned: pd.DataFrame = handler.preprocess(cleaner)
    df_encoded, encoder = handler.encode_labels()
    train_df, test_df = handler.split()

    classifier: TextClassifier = TextClassifier(MODEL_NAME)
    eval_pipe: EvaluationPipeline = EvaluationPipeline(classifier)
    eval_pipe.evaluate(test_df["clean_text"].tolist(), test_df["label_encoded"].tolist(), encoder)

    # Bonus: Generating sentence embeddings (optional use case)
    embed_gen: EmbeddingGenerator = EmbeddingGenerator(MODEL_NAME)
    embeddings: np.ndarray = embed_gen.get_embeddings(test_df["clean_text"].tolist()[:10])
    print("Embeddings shape:", embeddings.shape)

Short Description:

This project implements a robust, high-performance NLP preprocessing pipeline capable of processing millions of documents using Pandas for large-scale data handling, Hugging Face Transformers for state-of-the-art classification, and advanced Regex for deep text cleaning. It is highly modular, extendable, and deployable in a production-scale enterprise ML pipeline.
